intro.speaker: narrator
pages: Long ago these lands were a verdant wonderland.
giant mammoths roamed the forests, huge birds eclipsed the sun with their mighty wings and beasts of
unimaginable size and power swam the lakes and rivers.
there was no place for man in this wild world...

intro.speaker: narrator
pages: Then the ice age began and killed everything.

intro.speaker: narrator
pages: Well, almost everything... i mean you wouldn't be here reading this if everything had died...
anyway, among the few creatures that survived was primitive man.
eking out a meagre and extremely chilly existence, huddled around fires in dismal caves.
so it was with one tribe in particular, the avnotaklu tribe, until one day...

cave-awakening.speaker: mumbo
pages: Chief! chiieeef! you have to come and see this!

cave-awakening.speaker: chief
pages: Mumbo! you buffoon! what's all this fuss?!?

cave-awakening.speaker: mumbo
pages: The-the-the-the-the ice! i-i-it's gone! th-th-the ice age is o-over!
the s-s-sun is sh-shining, the birds are s-s-singing...
it's beautiful!

cave-awakening.speaker: chief
pages: What are you gibbering about? i didn't know you had a stutter?!?

cave-awakening.speaker: mumbo
pages: I d-d-don't chief, it's cold out there that's all!
you don't understand, we can go outside again!

cave-awakening.speaker: chief
pages: What?!? outside?!?
i always knew you were a mammoth short of a herd mumba, but this
takes the cake!

cave-awakening.speaker: mumbo
pages: What's a cake? oh never mind that now, come and see for yourself!

cave-awakening.speaker: chief
pages: By all that's unwashed and hairy, he's right!
i always knew you were a clever one mumba! triiiiiiibe! listen up!

cave-awakening.speaker: chief
pages: The time has come to leave this cave and venture forth!
get your behinds out there!

arrival.speaker: mumbo
pages: It...
it's been so long since we saw the sunlight playing on the water,
the animals gamboling on the lush green grass, the trees
swaying gently in the breeze...

arrival.speaker: chief
pages: I'm hungry! and it's cold! go and find me some shelter...
and get me something to eat while you're at it!
what do you think this is, a poetry workshop?
jump to it you slack-jawed simpletons!

arrival.speaker: mumbo
pages: Thousands of years in a cave and all he can think about is his
stomach...
well, better get building...
let's start with some huts, a store and a kitchen, we'll need to
gather materials to build with...
let's get to work!

mumbo-hello.speaker: mumbo
pages: Hi there, they say that i could talk the hind legs off a mammoth, so
i've been chosen to teach you how to get things done around
here.
At the top of the screen you can see the current population of
our tribe, the amount of living space and the amount of recources
we have stored.

tut-chiefs-hut.speaker: mumbo
pages: The building in front of me is the hub of our village, the chief's hut.
this is where our cultured, sensitive...
well this is where our chief lives anyway.
first-rate chap, by the way, if a little unhinged.
sometimes the elders gather here to sleep- errr, i mean discuss
vital issues!
First of all let's build a store for the things we gather.
tap the build button in the bottom right corner to open the
building list.
find the store, its cost is shown under its picture.
tap it and a see-through store will appear on the map.
hold the store and drag it onto a free space.
green underneath means it fits, red means it can't go there.
once you have found a suitable space, tap the tick at its top right to
place the building.

tut-building-site.speaker: mumbo
pages: Good! now we must send a villager to the building site.
tap any villager to select them.
Once selected, an information panel will appear at the bottom
of the screen, see?
take a look around, i'll wait here...
don't worry, i'm not in any hurry...
i mean, it's not as if i have my own things to be getting on with...

tut-skills.speaker: mumbo
pages: Each person has a set of skills.
when they're young, their skills are very basic.
as a villager performs a task their skill in that task gets higher.
the higher the skill, the better and faster the task is performed.
Select a villager with a high building skill, then tap the building
site to send them to build the store.
an icon flashes where you tapped to show the order was given.
notice how his building skill improves as he builds it.

tut-more-builders.speaker: mumbo
pages: If you're in a hurry, or just pure impatient, you can send an additional
worker to the yard to help build it faster.
Let's gather some wood and stones to build with.
select a villager, then tap a tree to send them to harvest wood.

tut-stones.speaker: mumbo
pages: Now do the same, but tap some stones instead of a tree,
there's plenty of them around, after all, this is the stone age!
i can't believe i just said that...

tut-huts-kitchen.speaker: mumbo
pages: Why don't we try and build some huts and a kitchen while we're
waiting for the store to be built.
gadzooks, was that a bear?!?
oh, it was just the chiefs stomach rumbling.
we'd better hurry up and gather some food.
that bush next to the chiefs hut is covered with berries, let's try
that.

tut-huts.speaker: mumbo
pages: Huts are needed for resting and... errrr...
privacy, if you take my meaning. you don't? oh...
well, when a caveman and a cavewoman love each other very much
they may decide to make a little caveperson...
that's why you need huts.
try and make sure everyone in the village has somewhere to
sleep or they get cranky.

tut-orders.speaker: mumbo
pages: Now let's try ordering some people about.
after all, what's the point in having all this power if you can't
abuse it?
press and hold on the map, then drag your finger to stretch a
frame over some villagers.
let go to select them as a group.
with a group selected, tap the '+' on the right to save them as a
squad.
tap the squad at any time to select them again, and the view
jumps to them.
press and hold it to replace or disband the squad.

tut-find-people.speaker: mumbo
pages: Let me show you another useful thing, that will help you to
find your villagers quickly.
tap the command button in the bottom right and choose
'villagers', a row of your villagers will appear at the bottom.
tap a face to see full information about that villager, then tap the
tick to select them.

kitchen-built.speaker: mumbo
pages: Ah good, the kitchen is finished...
notice the exclamation mark on it?
that means we need to find someone to cook for us.
select a villager, then tap the kitchen to send them to cook.

tut-mumbo-leaves.speaker: mumbo
pages: Good job! i'm going to grab some food, i'll be back a bit later.
in the meantime you can practice what you've learnt, there's still
much to do!

savages-coming.speaker: mumbo
pages: Chief! some strange feral looking men are running towards the
camp very quickly, what should we do?

savages-coming.speaker: chief
pages: Ah, it's probably just our new neighbours coming to
congratulate us on our fine new village!
or maybe they're door to door salesmen?

savages-coming.speaker: mumbo
pages: Ermmm... they look very angry...
and they seem to be brandishing clubs in a threatening manner...

savages-coming.speaker: chief
pages: Nonsense! who on earth would want to harm us?
now go and welcome them! that's an order!

savages-coming.speaker: mumbo
pages: Y-y-yes chief... *gulp*

savages-coming.speaker: chief
pages: What is it with people and stutters around here?

savages-coming.speaker: mumbo
pages: Arrrgh! that hurts! ouch! why? oh god why!

savages-coming.speaker: chief
pages: Oh my... i guess they're not friendly after all...
we'd probably better stop them...

tut-call-to-arms.speaker: mumbo
pages: Me again!
now seems like the perfect opportunity to teach you the 'call to
arms' command!
this command will order all of your villagers to grab
whatever weapons are available and assemble at a location.
tap the command button (the horn) in the bottom right and
choose 'call to arms!
'. a flag appears in the middle of the screen: drag the map to put it
where they should gather, then tap the tick.

tut-send-back.speaker: mumbo
pages: Scary aren't they? i wouldn't want to mess with them...
to send them back to work, tap the command button again and
choose 'back to work'!

close-call.speaker: mumbo
pages: Well that was a close call, we could have been toast then!

close-call.speaker: chief
pages: What's toast?
lucky i noticed their violent intentions, otherwise someone
could've gotten hurt!
well... someone else could've gotten hurt.
it seems that our neighbours may have different dietary
requirements to us...
one of them bit me!

close-call.speaker: mumbo
pages: You don't mean that they're...

close-call.speaker: chief
pages: Yes! zombies! it's probably only a matter of time before i turn!
save me!

close-call.speaker: mumbo
pages: I was actually thinking cannibals chief...
but your explanation is far more plausible.
either way, we'd better start thinking about protecting ourselves
unless we want to spend our last minutes smothered in ketchup
with wooden stakes up our...

close-call.speaker: chief
pages: You're right!
i know let's build ourselves a gym, with a spar and a juice bar
and a flirty receptionist named 'kim'!

close-call.speaker: shaman
pages: Yes! well, no! but yes to the gym!
and we can make ourselves new and better weapons!
fists and stones are no match for spears and clubs!
let's build ourselves an armoury too!

close-call.speaker: chief
pages: We should also build some kind of range where we can improve
our throwing skills...

close-call.speaker: mumbo
pages: You mean like a throwing range?

close-call.speaker: chief
pages: Exactly! egads i'm clever, no wonder i'm chief!
so then, i hereby decree that we must build a gym, an armoury and a
throwing range!
we'll be ready if those zombies come after us again!
And don't forget to keep an eye out!
we never know when our cannibalistic counterparts will
come sniffing around here again!
we must keep our people safe... especially me!

tut-weapons.speaker: mumbo
pages: What the chief wants, the chief gets.
to train warriors we'll need weapons.
after all, what's a warrior without a weapon?
let's build an armoury, to make weapons and a gym and a range for
our warriors to learn how to use them.

tut-chief.speaker: mumbo
pages: I ought to mention a bit about the chief.
being chief is a big deal around here, everyone looks to them for
guidance and support.
whoever is chief gives a bonus to themselves and everyone around
them in whatever task they are doing.
for example, warriors will fight harder if the chief is around.
look busy, the boss is coming!

tut-happiness.speaker: mumbo
pages: While those are building, let's talk about happiness.
are you happy? i hope so!
in the tribe, happiness determines how willing people are to
reproduce and work.
unhappy people will mope about and ignore your commands.
rest, food and 'tent-time' raise their spirits.
enemy attacks, death, especially the chief's death, hunger,
tiredness and a lack of living space will depress your villagers.
Keep an eye out for what people are thinking, people's
wants and needs appear as thoughts above their heads.
this will help you to understand how to make them happy.
Let's see if we can't put some smiles on these faces!
we can upgrade huts so that people recuperate faster in them, plus
they make for a more romantic environment.
i mean which would you choose? a hovel or a 5 star hotel?

tut-upgrade-hut.speaker: mumbo
pages: To upgrade the hut, tap it and choose 'upgrade' in the building panel at
the bottom.
you'll need to get a builder in to actually finish the task.
Repairing works in a similar way to upgrading.
if a building is damaged the repair button will appear in its panel
when you tap it.

armoury-built.speaker: mumbo
pages: Ah the armoury is ready, it's time to lock and load!
first of all we need to find someone to man it.
select someone and then tap the armoury.
now, with nobody selected, tap the armoury again: the
panel at the bottom shows which weapons you can make here.
each weapon's cost is shown under it.
swipe left or right to change how many to make, and the
armourer will spring into action!

tut-weapon-store.speaker: mumbo
pages: When the armourer finishes making a weapon he will bring it
to the store for your villagers to collect.
let's arm a villager.
with nobody selected, tap the store to see what's been made and
how many.
tap a weapon, then tap the tribe member you want to arm on the map
and tap the tick.
there we go. careful! you'll have someone's eye out with that!
to arm more villagers, choose a weapon from the store again.

tut-training.speaker: mumbo
pages: Now you can send the armed villagers to train, by selecting
them and clicking on the gym.
just remember that they must have a weapon to train.
when their skill reaches maximum they will leave the gym of
their own accord.

warriors-arrive.speaker: mumbo
pages: Hail chief, here are our finest and most ferocious warriors!

warriors-arrive.speaker: chief
pages: Good, good, they look like they could give those zombies a good
pummeling!
now let's go and see what sort of decrepit hovels those
man-eating psychopaths call home...
who knows, maybe we'll be able to reason with them?

do-better.speaker: mumbo
pages: Not bad but we can do better!
let's have a think about how we can improve it.
don't worry though, real warriors are tempered in the fray!
It's time to go and take on the world!
tap the command button and choose 'form up!
', drag the map to put the flag where they should gather, then
tap the tick.
this will gather all of your available warriors at that spot.
to send them away again, choose 'dismiss' from the command
button.

peace-talk.speaker: mumbo
pages: Dear man-eating psychopaths, we....

peace-talk.speaker: cannibal
pages: Grrrrr! rwwaaooorrrr! grrrrr!

peace-talk.speaker: mumbo
pages: We come in peace!

peace-talk.speaker: cannibal
pages: Grrrr! woof! woof! grrrrrrrrrrr!

peace-talk.speaker: mumbo
pages: We'd better get out of here now if we want to leave in peace, one piece
that is!
leg it!

not-friends.speaker: mumbo
pages: We found them and it appears that they're not interested in being
our friends...
in fact i think they want to kill and eat us all.
and there are lots of them...

not-friends.speaker: chief
pages: Nonsense! our men are worth three of theirs!

not-friends.speaker: mumbo
pages: Even if that were true, they'd still outnumber us ten to one!

not-friends.speaker: chief
pages: I see... that's a lot of slavering, blood-crazed maniacs...
maybe we should wait until our numbers have grown before we pick a
fight...

fish-and-hunt.speaker: mumbo
pages: Now that we are armed to the teeth, we can fish or hunt to get
food.
hunting gives not only food but also bones, which are needed to
make better weapons and upgrade buildings.
To fish, select a tribesman with a spear and tap where the fish
splash in the water.
Hunting can be dangerous, wild animals will attack
your hunters so they must be well trained and armed.

ready.speaker: mumbo
pages: Ok, now you should know everything you need to survive.
but keep your wits about you, because your tribe doesn't have
any of their own!

m2-intro.speaker: narrator
pages: Thus the avnotaklu tribe chased it's hostile neighbours from the land.
they liked the look of their enemies village, particularly what they had done with the curtains.
so they decided to move in.
they found the land bounteous, with animals roaming free and fruit in abundance.
and so the elders met to discuss the tribes' fate and how to get the smell of cooked caveman out of the carpet...

enemy-among-us.speaker: chief
pages: Our enemy could be anywhere...
he may even be amongst us right now! is it you? or you? hmmm?

enemy-among-us.speaker: mumbo
pages: They're cannibals not chameleons chief...
besides, our builders have learnt to craft watch towers, so that
we can see further and defend from range.
we should build some around the village and post sentries.

enemy-among-us.speaker: shaman
pages: We lost many people in the last fight...
if we have another head on confrontation like that there'll be none
of us left...
we should build a place where we can study the art of stealth and
misdirection, so that we can take our foes by surprise.

enemy-among-us.speaker: chief
pages: I like it! we could call them the pia!
the prehistoric intelligence agency!
we'll need to give them badges...

enemy-among-us.speaker: mumbo
pages: Ooooookay, on a slightly less whimsical note, our armourer
says that he can produce better weapons and traps to
keep the savage crazies at bay.

enemy-among-us.speaker: chief
pages: You know guys... i've been thinking...
maybe the gods are angry with us?

enemy-among-us.speaker: mumbo
pages: What gods?

enemy-among-us.speaker: chief
pages: You know, the gods... the ones that make it rain and stuff!

enemy-among-us.speaker: mumbo
pages: Isn't that a bit of an assumption?
i mean, maybe it's water vapour gathering in the skies and forming
clouds, which then burst and release the water back onto the
earth?

enemy-among-us.speaker: chief
pages: Pffffftt, listen to yourself and your 'watery ghost clouds'!
you're crazy you are!
besides, now is not the time for a theological debate!
let us honour the gods with a sanctuary... just in case.
I want to see towers, a pia centre and a sanctuary  to the gods
built by sunrise!

cannibals-speak.speaker: cannibal
pages: We here speak!

cannibals-speak.speaker: mumbo
pages: Haha! look, he's trying to speak! haha!

cannibals-speak.speaker: cannibal
pages: You take we land! we take land back!

cannibals-speak.speaker: mumbo
pages: Our land now! you go or we kill! you illiterate... err...
no-speak-no-good person!

cannibals-speak.speaker: cannibal
pages: Well i say! there's no need to be rude! right! that's it!
no more mister nice-savage!

fight-back.speaker: mumbo
pages: Are we gonna take this lying down?
i say we give these ragamuffins a damn good hiding!

fight-back.speaker: chief
pages: Oh wise and venerable shaman, what do the gods say?

fight-back.speaker: shaman
pages: Hang on a mo... uh-huh.. yup.. yeah, they say do it.

fight-back.speaker: chief
pages: Well, if the gods say we go, that's good enough for me!
are you sure that's what they said?

fight-back.speaker: shaman
pages: Of course i'm sure, would i lie to you?

fight-back.speaker: chief
pages: Oh, right, yes..
then let's show these savages what it means to trifle with the
avnotaklu!

captives.speaker: cannibal
pages: I say, that's shown them!
these helpless women and children look delectable!
You thought you'd won, but we tricked you!
muaha-ahaha-ahem... yes, very clever.

taken-away.speaker: mumbo
pages: They've nicked all our women and kids!

taken-away.speaker: shaman
pages: Woohoo! we're free! free from the yolk of female oppression!

taken-away.speaker: mumbo
pages: What are you so happy about genius?!?
don't you know the first thing about reproduction?
who's going to have our babies! we're done for!

taken-away.speaker: chief
pages: Come men! let us go and save our people from the cooking pot!

m3-intro.speaker: narrator
pages: And so it was that the avnotaklu separated and went in search of their families...
they searched high and low, near and far and farther still, higher and lower and... well you get the idea...

smell-food.speaker: chief
pages: Mmmmm, do you smell that? it smells delicious!
i'm starving, what do you think they're cooking?

smell-food.speaker: mumbo
pages: Your family idiot!
we must find our way to them as soon as we can!
there is no time to lose!

sabretooth.speaker: mumbo
pages: Crikey! that's a lot of big sharp pointy teeth!
we'd better sneak around them... you go first!

sabretooth.speaker: shaman
pages: Why me?

sabretooth.speaker: mumbo
pages: Age... before beauty...?

sabretooth.speaker: shaman
pages: Oh never mind!

enemy-camp.speaker: mumbo
pages: Ssssssshhh! i think that's their settlement...
let's see if we can't get closer...

enemy-camp.speaker: shaman
pages: Okay good luck!

enemy-camp.speaker: mumbo
pages: I was actually thinking of sending the scout we have next to us...

enemy-camp.speaker: shaman
pages: Oh right! yes, of course...
are you sure you don't want me to go? because i would go...
only i've got this cough...

enemy-camp.speaker: scout
pages: I'll just go then shall i? fine.

scout-report.speaker: scout
pages: I've found them!
the guards are old and weak and all the others are busy
dancing round a fire...
stupid primitives!
i say we rush in, kill them all and leave as heroes!

scout-report.speaker: mumbo
pages: or we could build this giant wooden mammoth, then we wait
til sundown and...

scout-report.speaker: shaman
pages: Are you mad?!? i don't want to get eaten! do you want to get eaten!
all covered in gravy... no wait, onion gravy... a fine wine...

scout-report.speaker: mumbo
pages: Shut up bonehead! we need a plan!

scout-report.speaker: shaman
pages: Oh yeah? well i have a plan!

scout-report.speaker: mumbo
pages: Oh yeah? what plan's that then?

scout-report.speaker: shaman
pages: We could lead a pack of ravenous blood thirsty tigers into
their camp and let them do our dirty work for us?

scout-report.speaker: mumbo
pages: Where are we going to get a large pack of ravenous blood
thirsty tigers at a time like this!?!

scout-report.speaker: shaman
pages: Sometimes i look at you and i fear for the future of our race...

lure-tiger.speaker: mumbo
pages: Here kitty kitty! who's a vicious little killer then, eh?

lure-tiger.speaker: mumbo
pages: You can't catch me nyah nyah!

lure-tiger.speaker: mumbo
pages: Eeep! time to leave!

find-captives.speaker: mumbo
pages: It looks like they've had their fill, we'd better find the women
and kids before they get hungry again!

find-captives.speaker: shaman
pages: They're in this hut... hmm the doors locked...
i think we're gonna have to break it down...

rescued.speaker: mumbo
pages: You saved us, our big strong, muscular heroes!

rescued.speaker: shaman
pages: Where's there a hut around here when you need one!

back-home.speaker: narrator
pages: And so the men and women of the avnotaklu tribe made their way back home, i won't bore you with the details, it's not
very interesting anyway...
but their joy at returning home was to be short lived...

village-flattened.speaker: chief
pages: Our village seems somewhat flatter than when we left it.
who's that curious looking chap over there?
what day is it today? what's my name?

village-flattened.speaker: mumbo
pages: I'll go talk to him... Hail stranger, we are the avnotaklu!
what brings you to our village? well what's left of it anyway...

village-flattened.speaker: jafar
pages: My name is jafar and i have come to lead you to the promised land!

village-flattened.speaker: mumbo
pages: Promised land?

village-flattened.speaker: jafar
pages: Yes, where the sun shines all year round, the trees are ripe with
the sweetest fruit and the women are beautiful and have
huge...

village-flattened.speaker: chief
pages: Where is this land?!? we're going there. immediately.

village-flattened.speaker: jafar
pages: Aha my friend!
my land lies far under the setting sun, where the women dance naked
in the moonlight, shaking their...

village-flattened.speaker: chief
pages: Right, come on, theres nothing for us here now except maybe
zombies, off we go!

village-flattened.speaker: mumbo
pages: Aren't you even curious about what happened to our village?
he didn't even tell us where this land is supposed to be?

village-flattened.speaker: jafar
pages: You must head south until the moon turns itself around.
errrrr, then go left.
then go straight on past the mountain, take another left and it
should be right in front of you...
dancing... naked...

village-flattened.speaker: chief
pages: Come on, we've wasted enough time! let's go!

village-flattened.speaker: mumbo
pages: But what about the elders?

village-flattened.speaker: chief
pages: They agree. look see, all agreeing. now move!

m4-intro.speaker: narrator
pages: And so it was that the avnotaklu once again left their homes.
you'd think they'd have learnt really, after everything they'd been through, but nooooo, they just had to go
gallivanting off...

m4-intro.speaker: narrator
pages: After many days a mountain loomed on the horizon and at it's feet there stood an oasis.
the tribesmen decided to build a camp to rest before continuing with their journey...

rest-stop.speaker: chief
pages: Let's stop here and rest a while.
we have water, food and there are no zombies as far as i can
see.

rest-stop.speaker: mumbo
pages: Chief, the tribe are miserable, they don't want to go any
further, can't we just go home?

rest-stop.speaker: chief
pages: No! we must carry on!
there's nothing but zombies for us back home!
we cannot give up on this naked dancing! paradise!
i mean paradise!

rest-stop.speaker: shaman
pages: You guys aren't gonna like this...
i've just had a chat with the guys upstairs and they say they're
not happy with us...

rest-stop.speaker: chief
pages: Behold! they have blocked the way back, tis a sign!
we must go on!

rest-stop.speaker: shaman
pages: It's a sign alright chief, a sign that we're stuffed!
i had this dream, yeah and we were all walking through the
desert and we were attacked by barbarians.
everyone ran away except the chief who turned and fought, but
they killed him...

rest-stop.speaker: mumbo
pages: Have you been eating those cactii again?

rest-stop.speaker: shaman
pages: Well... yeah... but that's not the point.
the gods are angry at us for betraying our leader.
so unless you all want to end up dead or enslaved by barbarians
you'd better do as i say and protect the chief.

rest-stop.speaker: mumbo
pages: Do we actually have any proof that you can talk to the gods?

rest-stop.speaker: shaman
pages: The gods say you're an idiot and they're gonna smite you to pieces if
you're not careful.

rest-stop.speaker: mumbo
pages: Oooooh, i'm scared!

rest-stop.speaker: chief
pages: Silence! i think you're missing the point here, i'm going to die! dead!
no naked dancing, just death!
and all you can think about is whether or not any of what he just
said is actually true!

rest-stop.speaker: mumbo
pages: You make a good case... alright, let's try and keep him in one piece!

found-cave.speaker: mumbo
pages: Chief! we've found a cave!
It looks deep, maybe it leads through the mountain?
shall we investigate?

found-cave.speaker: chief
pages: Are you nuts?
we've spent thousands of years in a cave and you want to go
scurrying back into the first one you find?!?
besides, what about the promised land? no way!

visitors.speaker: mumbo
pages: Chief! looks like we may have some visitors...

visitors.speaker: stranger
pages: A thousand greetings, oh mighty chief, we've been expecting you!

visitors.speaker: chief
pages: You! where is this promised land! i see no naked dancing!
we've trekked for days across the desert to get here, thanks to
you!

visitors.speaker: stranger
pages: This is not the land you seek, but you are here!
and we are in need of slaves, yes, dire need!
it is you who will dance for us fat boy! Attack!
take the women and the children... kill the old ones and the chief!
especially the chief!

visitors.speaker: mumbo
pages: The prophecy! that cactii-addled shaman was right!
protect the chief!

news.speaker: mumbo
pages: Do you want the good news or the bad news?

news.speaker: chief
pages: Errmmm, the bad news, then the good news will make it better.

news.speaker: mumbo
pages: Well the bad news is that there's only one way out of this hell
hole and that's through the enemies camp.

news.speaker: chief
pages: But that's terrible! what's the good news!

news.speaker: mumbo
pages: There is no good news... i just didn't want you to hit me...

news.speaker: chief
pages: Then we'll cut our way through! just as well that you let me know.
and don't worry, i'm not going to hit you...
i'm going to hit you lots!

news.speaker: mumbo
pages: Ouch! i should've seen that coming.
our people are in a bad way, i'll go talk to the shaman about healing
them...
starting with me.

watering-hole.speaker: mumbo
pages: It seems like we've built our camp near someones watering
hole...
those tigers don't look pleased to see us!

watering-hole.speaker: chief
pages: Zombies, tigers, barbarians, what next?
we'd better keep an eye on them... those teeth look sharp!

watering-hole.speaker: mumbo
pages: Hmmm, we used them against our enemies once...
why not try it again?

watering-hole.speaker: chief
pages: Well volunteered!
better get training, those cats can run pretty fast you know!

watering-hole.speaker: shaman
pages: I've learned some new moves, yeah?
i can conjure disease on the ground and give people niagra to...
well... get them in the mood...
the gods say i'll need a better sanctuary though...
and as many wives as i want.

watering-hole.speaker: chief
pages: We're going to have to use every means at our disposal to get out of
this place if we want our freedom.

m5-intro.speaker: narrator
pages: Finally the avnotaklu had gained their freedom once more, though to be honest, so far it had bought them nothing
but trouble.
they found themselves surrounded by a beautiful sprawling dale, well equipped to sustain them for
generations to come.
and so they decided to settle there..

m6-intro.speaker: narrator
pages: Finally the avnotaklu had gained their freedom once more, though to be honest, so far it had bought them nothing
but trouble.
they found themselves surrounded by a beautiful sprawling dale, well equipped to sustain them for
generations to come.
and so they decided to settle there..

arrival-promised-land.speaker: chief
pages: We have journeyed far and wide to find this place and despite the
distinct lack of naked dancing, it's pretty good!
We have nowhere to go home to and i am tired of wandering, so let us
make this place our home.
we do not know what danger lies in store, but we shall defend
our new home against all comers!
We do not know when peril will strike... oh there it is.

victory.speaker: chief
pages: Well, that showed them.
here we will build the settlement to end all settlements and more
importantly, our home!
now get on with it!

barbarians.speaker: chief
pages: More barbarians!
i've had enough of these guys, let's deal with them once and for
all!
we will fight for peace!

barbarians.speaker: mumbo
pages: Err, fighting for peace?
isn't that a bit of a contradiction in terms?

barbarians.speaker: chief
pages: Shut up and start killing!

ending.speaker: narrator
pages: And so it was that the avnotaklu came to find their home.
so if you ever wonder why we are the way we are, all you have to do is look at where we came from!

shaman-intro.speaker: shaman
pages: Alright?
i'm the shaman, i'm the gods' voice around here which means i get
to do pretty much whatever i like, yeah?
this is my sanctuary, where i heal the sick and wounded but i can
also use my voodoo outside.
I can only do two spells at the moment but as the gods get to
know me they will show me more.
'healing' heals people and 'defence' means they get hurt less in
combat.
If you want to heal someone, just send him here.
you can also tap the sanctuary, choose the spell in its panel and
then tap the villager.
you can also queue people and i will  deal with them in turn, just
don't rush me, yeah?
the same goes for 'defence', communing with the gods has
never been so easy!

pia-intro.speaker: scout
pages: Hi, i'm the first member of the prehistoric intelligence agency.
we can see further than your average tribesman and can hide
in bushes to become undetectable.
the higher our skill, the closer we can get to the enemy without
being seen.
we know everything about everyone... including you!
We can also detect enemy scouts, but that door can swing both
ways, so we must be careful about sneaking up on people.
still, we'll learn more in time, no-one can hide from us, no-one!

shaman-upgraded.speaker: shaman
pages: Yeah that's more like it!
i can brew the niagra love potion now and call forth plagues to
smite the enemy!
niagra stimulates passion and makes villagers more likely
to go and rattle huts...
'disease' is a nasty spell, so you'd better be careful with it.
it doesn't differentiate friend from foe and it spreads quick!
beware the power of the gods... yeah?

upgrade-kitchen.speaker: mumbo
pages: I think we need a bigger kitchen...
we can upgrade it to make it seat more and be more comfortable.
this will make the villagers happier!

upgrade-armoury.speaker: mumbo
pages: An upgrade is available for the armoury, this will allow us to make
better weapons and traps!

upgrade-gym.speaker: mumbo
pages: We can upgrade the gym and the range now, which will mean that
our warriors can train their skills higher and increase their hit
points quicker!
feel the burn!

upgrade-disco.speaker: mumbo
pages: We could add a jacuzzi and a bar to the disco, to help these jive
turkeys mellow, you dig?
alright!

upgrade-tower.speaker: mumbo
pages: Our towers can be upgraded, to make them sturdier and more
resilient to attack.

upgrade-sanctuary.speaker: mumbo
pages: We can improve the sanctuary, which will allow our shaman to
cast better spells.

upgrade-pia.speaker: mumbo
pages: The pia centre can be upgraded now!
this will allow our agents to train their skill higher!
